checks.name: explicit-write-default-read-durability-guard-rollback
checks.run:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
from mission_control.db import connection
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    path = Path(folder) / "state.sqlite"
    with connection(path) as baseline:
        assert not baseline.in_transaction
    with connection(path, write=True) as db:
        assert db.in_transaction
        db.execute("CREATE TABLE records(value INTEGER)")
        db.execute("INSERT INTO records VALUES(1)")
        assert db.execute("PRAGMA synchronous").fetchone()[0] == 2
    with connection(path) as db:
        assert not db.in_transaction
        assert db.execute("SELECT value FROM records").fetchone()[0] == 1
        assert not db.in_transaction
    def reject(path, db, committing=False):
        if committing:
            raise PermissionError("fixture revoke")
    try:
        with patch("mission_control.automation_execution.guard_connection", side_effect=reject):
            with connection(path, write=True) as db:
                db.execute("INSERT INTO records VALUES(2)")
    except PermissionError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Guard must revoke commit")
    with connection(path) as db:
        assert db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM records").fetchone()[0] == 1
